lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Circular spots of high pixel intensity arranged in a non-uniform grid posterior to the gill slits, following a loosely rectangular spatial distribution across the lateral midsection.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical linear features of higher luminance intersect the horizontal rows of spots, creating anchor nodes most prominent in the area immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear features in the upper dorsal region characterized by a high-contrast luminance gradient, with higher pixel intensity on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin contains a high-density population of smaller-diameter high-luminance clusters distinct from the primary lateral flank patterning.
